verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents OpenAI API compatibility, where existing apps switch by changing the API key, base URL, and model ID. It also publishes an OpenAPI spec for /v1/chat/completions and supports the standard image_url shape, so an agent can swap to or from it with only configuration-level changes. Two caveats keep this at partial: the model ID must still change, and one hands-on report hit a 422 wrong_api_format error through claude-code-router, so drop-in parity is not fully proven. missing for 10: independent confirmation that agents can switch mid-workflow with no adaptation, full documented parity with the OpenAI request/response surface (beyond the key, base URL, and model ID swap), and a resolution of the reported wrong_api_format incompatibility.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent switch to or away from this provider mid-workflow because it speaks the standard chat-completions API without provider-specific code changes

citations.quote: Existing applications can use Cerebras by changing the API key, base URL, and model ID.
OpenAI API compatibility lets developers build on Cerebras with just two code changes.
The standard OpenAI `image_url` content shape is supported.
